meaning:
ἐκ-κλίνω
[in LXX for נָטָה, סוּר, etc. ;]
intrans., to turn aside, turn away: metaphorically, from the right path, absol., Rom.3:12 (LXX); from evil, absol., 1Pe.3:11; before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), Rom.16:17.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
